title: Train and evaluate the credit model
description: You follow batch updates and distinguish validation AUC from thresholded accuracy.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You build a receiver operating characteristic curve by varying the score threshold and counting true and false positives. Trapezoidal integration computes its area, AUC.
You shuffle row indices each epoch and update the model on batches. Each batch produces a loss L and gradients g.

steps.question: Does the stored loss average all batches in the epoch?
steps.answer: It stores L from the final batch. The validation AUC uses predictions on all of Xv.

steps.description: You store both histories and print every tenth epoch across 80 epochs. The recorded final validation AUC is 0.636.
You classify test probabilities at the supplied threshold and measure the fraction matching y_te. The recorded test accuracy is 0.674.
